transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because I just feel like something in me shut off. Like, I’ll be sitting with my husband or trying to watch my shows after work, and I know I should feel comfortable or happy or something… but I just don’t. It’s like there’s nothing there.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About three weeks now. It started after that pallet collapsed at work and hurt my coworker. Since then, I just haven’t felt right.
Do you still enjoy activities that you used to find pleasurable before this incident at work?

No, not really. I’ll sit with my husband or put on one of my shows after work, and I know I used to feel comfortable or happy doing that… but now it’s just kind of blank. Like the warm part of me shut off.
Do you feel sad most of the time since this incident happened at work?
I don’t know if I’d call it sad most of the time. It’s more like I feel kind of numb or empty. I’m not really crying or anything… I just don’t feel like myself.
Are there any activities that you still enjoy or find pleasure in since this incident happened?

Not really. I mean, I still try to sit with my husband or watch my shows after work, but I don’t really get anything from it. I know those things used to feel comforting, maybe even make me a little happy, but now it just feels like there’s nothing there.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in things you used to enjoy?

Yeah… I think so. I still do the same things, like sitting with my husband or putting on my shows after work, but it doesn’t feel good the way it used to. I know it should feel comforting, but it’s just kind of empty, like that warm feeling is gone.
Do you feel sad most of the time?
I’m not sure I’d say sad most of the time. It’s more like I just feel blank or off. Like I know I’m supposed to feel something, but I don’t really.
Have you lost any weight since you started feeling this way?
I don’t really know. I haven’t been checking my weight, and I haven’t noticed my clothes fitting differently or anything.
Have you been having any thoughts about death or wishing you were dead since you started feeling this way?
I… I don’t think so. I haven’t been thinking about being dead or wanting to die. It’s more like I feel numb, but not like I want to hurt myself.
Do you feel like you have less energy than you used to?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I get tired like anyone, but I haven’t clearly noticed that my energy is way lower than before.
Do you feel sad most of the time when you're alone?
I’m not sure. I wouldn’t say I feel sad most of the time when I’m alone. Sometimes I just feel kind of blank or off, but I haven’t really been tracking it like that.
Do you feel more tired than you used to?

Yeah… I think I do, mostly because I’m not sleeping right. After my late shift I’ll be exhausted, but then when I’m about to fall asleep I jerk awake like I heard pallets shifting. Even when I do sleep, I wake up feeling like I didn’t really rest.
Have you noticed any change in your appetite since you started feeling this way?
I haven’t really noticed a big change. I mean, I still eat, maybe some days I don’t think about it as much, but I wouldn’t say my appetite is clearly different.
Do you feel sad most of the time?
Not really most of the time, no. I have moments where I feel down or just not like myself, but I wouldn’t say I’m sad all day or most of the time.
Do you feel sad most of the day?
No, I don’t think it’s most of the day. I get upset sometimes, but it’s not like I’m sad all day.
Do you feel sad?
I mean, sometimes I do feel sad, yeah. It kind of comes and goes, though. It’s not like I’m sad all the time.
Do you feel sad?
Yeah, sometimes I do. I just don’t really know how to say more than that—it’s not constant.
Do you feel sad?
I’ve answered that as best I can. Yeah, I feel sad sometimes, but I don’t have much more to add.
Do you feel that this sadness is mild or it interferes with your daily life significantly?

It’s interfering, yeah. I’m not really able to do my regular receiving work right now. I froze during a pallet move and then snapped at someone, and my supervisor had to take me off the floor because I wasn’t working safely.
Would you describe your sadness as mild or severe?
I’d say it’s more moderate than severe. It’s not crushing every minute, but it’s definitely affecting me.
